Of course, I'd love to take it

I am the youngest of three
brothers.

The main character is the youngest

My family runs a major company.
My older brothers are smart and
athletic.

My family runs a major company.

My second brother supports the

My second brother supports the

Parents wrote me off as useless,
Letting me slack through college

Parents wrote me off as useless,

Only one woman supported him:

Only one woman supported him:

They were mismatched, but soon

pointers.MT Text:
They were mismatched, but soon

But she was engaged to his

But she was engaged to his

It's clear at a glance who will

It's obvious who I'd be happy with

The main character tries to

The main character tries to back out

...This far. From here on, I'll
leave it to Nekozawa-senpai.
pointers.MT Text:
...This far. From here on, I'll
leave it to Nekozawa-senpai.

Sad and beautiful! What's next
for him?! Nekozawa, guess what
happens!!
pointers.MT Text:
Sad and beautiful! What's next
for him?! Nekozawa, guess what

pointers.Original Text: 環先輩がハンカチをかみ締めて猫澤先輩に詰め寄る。

Takashi, grab your hankie,
'cause Tamaki's about to pounce
on Kurakano-senpai.
pointers.MT Text:
Takashi, grab your hankie,

...The protagonist breaks free

......The protagonist shakes off the

At her wedding to his brother, a
letter arrives for the hero.
pointers.MT Text:
At her wedding to his brother, a

The protagonist, moved by the
letter's contents, rushes to the
wedding venue in a panic...
pointers.MT Text:
The protagonist is moved by the

wedding venue...

pointers.New Text:
Bride veiled in white kissed on
altar...
pointers.MT Text:
Bride veiled in white kissed on
altar...

As her tear fell, the door burst

As her tear fell, the door burst

'You may not be happy with me.'
Still, the bride smiled and
said...
pointers.MT Text:
'You may not be happy with me.'

Just being with you makes me
happy... This is how our story
ends...
pointers.MT Text:
Being with you is enough to make me

Bravo! A story that moved me!
Nekozawa-senpai, thank you! What
a tale!
pointers.MT Text:
Bravo! A story that moved me!
Nekozawa-senpai, thank you! What

Ring sniffs, nose runs, Nekozawa
drained.

Ring sniffs, nose runs, Nekozawa
drained.

I was moved too. I rarely watch
movies, but I wanted to finish
this one.

I was moved too. I rarely watch

That was indeed a wonderful
scenario. However, unfortunately
this work remains unfinished.

...It was indeed a great scenario.

pointers.New Text:
I would have accepted
'unfinished,' but he overthought
the ending.
pointers.MT Text:
I would have accepted
'unfinished,' but he overthought
the ending.

It was a bit of a mean question,
but...
pointers.MT Text:
Maybe it was a bit of a mean
question,

pointers.Original Text: 「いえ、負けは負けですので、そちらの要望に従いたいと思います……」
pointers.New Text:
No, I lost fair and square, so I
want to follow your request...
pointers.MT Text:
No, I lost fair and square, so I
want to follow your request...

It was a trick question, but do
you think I'm awful for doing
it?
pointers.MT Text:
It was a trick question, but do

something.

I see. If you'll defend Nekozawa

Nekozawa-senpai set stage.

Nekozawa-senpai set stage.

The Host Club's prophecy hall

The Host Club's prophecy hall

I'm stuck as Nekozawa's errand
kid.

I'm stuck as Nekozawa's errand

(...Maybe it was wrong to defy

If I could go back to that

Well, this is just the natural

Well, this is just the natural

Nekoze-senpai dragged Tama-chan

Tamaki's presence just makes

Having Kan around just makes things

wanted.

That so...? That ending might

So I was looking forward to

The prophecy hall needs losing
Black Magic members as extras

Even now, Black Magic Club

Even now, Black Magic Club

Is this also part of your master
plan...?

Could it be that this was all

Of course, I had calculated some
